description.p: Hold a key, say it, and Blurt types clean, filler-free text into whatever app has focus on your GNOME desktop. Speech is transcribed with OpenAI when you let go, cleaned of fillers, false starts and repeated words, and handed to GNOME's input method.

ul.li: Hold Ctrl, Alt or Shift to talk, or use a start/stop shortcut
Types into terminals, browsers and GTK apps, accents and emoji included
A top bar menu shows when Blurt is listening, transcribing, or needs attention
A searchable history of everything you dictated
Estimated spend per day and per model, against a monthly budget
